async.description:
By default, the tracker will start the jobs in the serial order and wait for all completions.
If async is set to true, the tracker will start all jobs and track their status asynchronously.

syncCheckInterval.description:
Job status check interval for the synchronize mode in seconds.
Default interval is 60 seconds.

asyncCronExpression.description:
Cron schedule expression to check the job status asynchronously.
Default schedule is every one minute.
